newsitem.title: USA: Sybron Int'l unit completes Remel purchase.
newsitem.headline: Sybron Int'l unit completes Remel purchase.

text.p: Sybron International Corp on Tuesday said its Erie Scientific Co subsidiary completed its acquisition of Remel LP, paying $120 million and assuming about $35 million in debt.
The debt was repaid at the closing, Sybron said.

Remel, a manufacturer of disposable diagnostic products used in laboratories, is expected to generate revenues this year of $63.3 million, with earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amoritization (EBITDA) at $23 million, Sybron said.
Frank Jellinek, president of Erie, said the acquisition was part of the company's strategy of providing one-stop shopping for products used in clinical laboratories.
